new_test_coverage_verified.verification: Read in full + confirmed it drives the REAL handler via a fake-pg pool (not mocked route logic): seedStartedTask writes a genuine process.started audit event via appendProcessStarted; first POST /action genuinely completes the step through the real approve code path; second POST on the same taskId is the one that exercises the new branch (confirmed no earlier short-circuit exists in the handler between body validation and findWaitingInstanceTask by reading inbox.ts:1877-1936 line by line). new_test_coverage_verified.test: inbox-action.test.ts: '404 NOT_FOUND (genuine) for a taskId that was never a real task at all — the already-done check must not mask this'
new_test_coverage_verified.verification: Confirmed this test seeds an UNRELATED task that is left WAITING (not approved/done) alongside the queried nonexistent taskId, which is the correct adversarial setup to rule out an accidental cross-match on inboxTaskId/status inside the new doneProjections.find(...) — a weaker test that seeded no other task at all would not have caught a bug where the new check matched the wrong row. Ran it live; it passes (404/NOT_FOUND).
